rules.statement: A purchaser for valuable consideration, without notice, obtains a legal estate in the property which is unanswerable to the jurisdiction of the court unless the purchaser can show that he had notice of a breach of trust.
rules.supporting_quote: "I propose simply to apply myself to the case of a purchaser for valuable consideration, Without notice, obtaining, upon the occasion of his purchase, and by means of his purchase deed, some legal estate, some legal right, some legal advantage; and, according to my view of the established law of this Court, such a purihaser's plea of a purchase for valuable consideration without notice is an absolute, unqualified, unanswerable defence, and an unanswerable plea to the jurisdiction of this Court."
